failure_audit.scope: Read-only evidence audit and proposed separate follow-up; no repairs, resumes, new search evaluations or paid launches.

restoration: Use receipt.index to enumerate exact relative member paths, sizes and SHA256. Download receipt.archive, verify its full SHA256 and every member before restoring. Separate worker archives map to simulation seeds; search archive and per-run checkpoints contain graph.sqlite and agents.sqlite where applicable.
storage_policy: Private S3 and committed W&B hold full scientific data, failed attempts and checkpoints. Public Git holds screened methods and compact results. Source archives and credentials excluded.
